title: A Bird in Our Apple Tree

paragraphs.text: Look at our apple tree. It is big and green. There are many red apples.
paragraphs.translation: 看看我们的苹果树吧。它又大又绿，上面结了许多红苹果。

paragraphs.text: A little bird comes here. It sits in the tree. It likes the red apples.
paragraphs.translation: 一只小鸟飞来了。它停在树上。它很喜欢这些红苹果。

paragraphs.text: My sister Amy sees the bird. She has a toy bird too. It is blue and small.
paragraphs.translation: 我的妹妹艾米看见了这只小鸟。她也有一个玩具小鸟。它是蓝色的，小小的。

paragraphs.text: The bird sings in the tree. Amy sings with the bird. They are happy.
paragraphs.translation: 小鸟在树上唱歌。艾米跟着小鸟一起唱。她们都很开心。

paragraphs.text: My father picks three apples. He gives one to Amy. He gives one to me. The apples are sweet and red.
paragraphs.translation: 爸爸摘了三个苹果。他给艾米一个，给我一个。苹果又甜又红。

paragraphs.text: The bird can fly home now. We say goodbye to it. Come again, little bird!
paragraphs.translation: 小鸟现在可以飞回家啦。我们跟它说再见。再来呀，小鸟！
